# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated alongside the core AppCAT report.

## Available documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - Application architecture and component interaction diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - HTTP endpoints, DTO contracts, and service communication flow.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Database profiles, entity model, and persistence-layer notes.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, secrets handling, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Core user workflows, business rules, and workflow sequence diagram.
